verdict.rationale: Granola's own API docs name this exact use case: extracting action items from meeting notes and automatically creating tasks in Linear, Jira, or other project tools. Its REST API (with workspace API keys), MCP server and Zapier integration provide the access, and Zapier's 8,000+ app reach implies tracker connections without naming one. However, the filing must be built by the user (custom code or a Zapier flow); there is no native Linear/Jira/Asana integration, and Chat workflows only cover email, Slack and Calendar. A community PM reports action items slipping through and built their own tool, which suggests the out-of-box flow is thin. Missing for 10: native project-tracker integrations, documented webhooks or event triggers on meeting completion, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end tracker filing flow.
